skill_used.description: The skill you actually routed to, e.g. ticker-analysis or market-scan. Empty string if you routed to none.

commands.description: Every shell command you actually ran, in order, verbatim.

final_response.description: The complete analysis you would give the user, in the language they asked in. This is the artifact being judged.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence from what you actually did: a command, an envelope field and value, or a quoted sentence of your own final_response. Never a restatement of the assertion.

limitations.description: What you could not read or verify in this environment.
